author: Claude
notes: Independently authored; no retrieval, benchmark, other-author questions or existing fixture queries were read or run. Expansions are plausible author-intent terms written before any retrieval. Before joint freezing, the orchestrator exchanged same-slice practice/evaluation assignments to remove cross-author fact overlap; question text, gold and expansions were unchanged. IDs retain their original author-assigned split labels. Three initially incorrect manifest paths were corrected to docs/guide before freezing.
